card.name: Digits inside long numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (or hyphen) in the middle of a long number, such as a journal page or ID number, a patient count with commas, a hex address or a phone number.

modes.label: Citation and ID numbers

modes.label: Counts in trial results
modes.description: A digit inside a thousands-formatted patient count.

modes.label: Phone and address codes
modes.description: A digit or hyphen inside a phone number or hex address.
